purpose: Season-to-date minutes, points, rebounds and assists for the players a team actually uses, so that minutes redistribution when a player is OUT is explicit (top-8 shares in, replacement shares out) instead of a hand-wave.
columns_used: GP, MIN, PTS, REB, AST. These are the page's Per Game values; the page prints them per game by default and the capture does not recompute anything.

completeness.status: INCOMPLETE — BY DESIGN, AND NOT FILLED IN
completeness.why: Each team's player table is one fetch, and the table's first data row is routinely split across the page's chunk boundary, which loses the player NAME while leaving the numbers. A row whose name was not read is not published: attributing a name from a player id would be an inference. Two teams came back with the rows intact, so they are published; the other 28 are recorded as not captured with the fetch that would fill them, and every downstream player-level figure is gated BLOCKED for those teams rather than estimated.
completeness.effect: Anytime points/rebounds/assists props and player-combination parlays are BLOCKED for 28 of 30 teams. They are NOT priced from a proxy.
completeness.to_complete_this: Re-run the capture asking for the row block plus one chunk either side, so the row that straddles the boundary is read whole. The capture brief for that is data/v2/captures/raw/CAPTURE_BRIEF_team_minutes.md.

teams.rows_printed_note: The '12 Rows' label was not in the chunk that was read, so the printed row count is recorded as null rather than counted by hand from a partial page.
teams.capture: rows 1-7 by minutes, read whole; row 8 (Baylor Scheierman, 20.7 minutes) had its REB/AST cells fall across the chunk boundary and is EXCLUDED rather than published with blanks

excluded_team_note.ATL: ATL's highest-minutes row (player id 1629638, 31.8 MIN, 21.5 PTS) lost its player NAME across the chunk boundary. The numbers were read but the name was not, and the top-8 cannot be published without it, so ATL is recorded as not captured. No name was inferred from the id.
